program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
            ([obj (in-list (filter filled? (objects g 0)))])
    (if (and (= (modulo (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)) 2) 0)
             (= (modulo (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)) 2) 0))
        (let ((rm (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2))
              (cm (quotient (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) 2)))
          (paint-cells
           (paint-cells out
                        (for/list ([c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))]) (list rm c))
                        (obj-color obj))
           (for/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))]) (list r cm))
           (obj-color obj)))
        out)))
